decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to use the Cascade mechanic to cast powerful spells for free, specifically Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the player can potentially overwhelm their opponent with a quick and aggressive strategy. The deck also includes other efficient interaction and card advantage tools to help maintain tempo and control the game. Ultimately, the goal is to flood the board with threatening creatures and spells while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards like Indomitable Creativity and Archon of Cruelty to quickly get powerful threats onto the battlefield, while controlling the opponent's board with spells like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce. The deck also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect your own combo pieces. Overall, the deck focuses on using creative combinations and synergies to outmaneuver and overwhelm the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck revolves around utilizing control elements and powerful elemental creatures to establish board dominance and disrupt opponents' strategies. By combining removal spells, card draw, and versatile threats like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation, the deck aims to outvalue opponents while maintaining control of the game. The inclusion of companions like Keruga, the Macrosage adds an additional layer of consistency and card advantage. With a diverse mana base and a mix of impactful creatures and spells, this deck aims to control the game and overwhelm opponents with powerful elemental synergies.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply pressure on the opponent quickly and efficiently. By making use of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, along with removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while dealing consistent damage. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Kolaghan's Command to disrupt the opponent's hand and board state. Additionally, cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Dauthi Voidwalker provide card advantage and graveyard manipulation to keep the pressure on the opponent.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces necessary to abuse Underworld Breach's ability to cast multiple spells from the graveyard. Using Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Mishra's Bauble to generate card advantage, the deck can loop through its graveyard, generating mana and casting spells until it can finish the game with either Grapeshot or a large enough Dragon's Rage Channeler. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional consistency to the deck's game plan. The key concept is to efficiently combo off and overwhelm the opponent with spells and creatures.

This deck revolves around utilizing The Underworld Cookbook to set up powerful graveyard interactions, such as bringing out Emrakul, the Aeons Torn with Goryo's Vengeance. It also utilizes Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for additional graveyard manipulation. The deck aims to be aggressive and efficient in its gameplay, utilizing cards like Insolent Neonate and Ovalchase Daredevil to apply pressure early on. The inclusion of Profane Tutor adds consistency to the deck's strategy, while Mausoleum Secrets and Bone Shards provide additional utility and removal options.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Leyline Binding early in the game. The deck also utilizes Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies. Wrenn and Six helps with mana fixing and recursion, while cards like Expressive Iteration and Prismari Command provide card advantage. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats before they have a chance to respond.

The deck focuses on using cycling creatures such as Street Wraith and Architect of Will to fill up the graveyard, then casting Living End to return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield for a powerful combo turn. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Grief and Force of Negation to control the opponent's board while setting up the combo. The goal is to outvalue opponents by consistently bringing back powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan.

The main idea of this Scapeshift control deck is to ramp up lands quickly and efficiently using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, then utilize cards like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Scapeshift to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent's life total. Cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Supreme Verdict provide control elements to help stall the game until the deck can assemble its win condition. Bring to Light allows for versatile tutoring, while Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and land recursion. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and win through a powerful Scapeshift combo.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of low-cost burn spells and fast attacking creatures. By efficiently dealing damage early in the game, the deck aims to close out the match before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack also helps to prevent the opponent from gaining life or disrupting the deck's aggressive strategy. Overall, the goal is to apply constant pressure and finish the game as swiftly as possible.

The main idea of the UW Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan using counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset. The deck aims to control the game tempo and card advantage by denying the opponent resources and answering threats efficiently. Key cards like Solitude and Shark Typhoon provide flexibility in dealing with different types of threats, while Chalice of the Void helps shut down low-cmc decks. The deck utilizes various control elements to outlast the opponent and secure victory through attrition and card advantage.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing powerful creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to control the board. The deck also features disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's strategy. With the help of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed, power, and disruption. Additionally, the deck includes tools like Urza's Saga and Wrenn and Six for additional value and consistency.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker from the deck. It also includes disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo. The presence of cards like Wrenn and Six, Dwarven Mine, and Xander's Lounge allows for additional value and synergy in the deck. The mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt, Prismatic Ending, and Prismari Command helps control the board while setting up the combo pieces.

The deck focuses on using Amulet of Vigor and various land bounce lands to generate mana and ramp quickly into powerful threats like Primeval Titan. By utilizing cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Explore, the deck aims to quickly ramp into a Primeval Titan and eventually search for combo pieces like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion to close out the game with massive damage. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove provide additional synergy and versatility to the deck's game plan.

The deck focuses on applying early pressure with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. It also uses removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board. The deck's mana base is optimized for casting spells on curve and locking opponents out of the game with cards like Blood Moon. The card advantage engine provided by Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps the deck maintain pressure and stay ahead in the resource game.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the combo of equipping a Colossus Hammer onto a creature with Puresteel Paladin on the battlefield, creating a powerful threat that can quickly end the game. The deck utilizes equipment tutors like Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga to find the necessary pieces, alongside support cards like Sigarda's Aid and Blacksmith's Skill to enable the combo. Additionally, the deck includes protection and disruption elements with cards like Giver of Runes, Solitude, and Esper Sentinel to help ensure the combo can successfully be executed.
